title: Handle an Escalated Customer Call
condition: Given an inbound call from a customer reporting a billing error, access to the account system, and the published refund policy.
standard: Verify the customer's identity, acknowledge the reported problem, resolve it within policy or escalate, and confirm the next steps before ending the call.
steps: Verify the caller's identity using two approved identifiers before discussing the account.
Acknowledge the reported problem and restate it to confirm understanding.
Apply the refund policy, or escalate to a supervisor when the amount exceeds the agent limit.
Confirm the agreed next steps and the expected timeline before closing the call.
